heroHeadline: DRC Ebola Deaths Pass 4,000 as Health Workers Protest Delayed Pay
heroSubtitle: The Health Ministry reports 4,018 Ebola deaths among about 8,300 confirmed cases, with Ituri the hardest-hit province. Fighting between government forces and M23 continues despite peace agreements, as the Security Council warned on Sept 29.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
